b2d3e985b344df72b5d6c8e5b13134cd720cfaa9.summary: Chinese-language forum post offering a Windows credential-dumping tool. It says the program is built on the open-source mimikatz project to pull plaintext passwords of logged-in users, and that it comes in four builds meant to ease antivirus evasion. The post is a tool-distribution listing with file hashes, not a threat analysis. It names no actors, campaigns, or incidents, and the download location is omitted.
